description: The root actor, held by the orchestrator thread. Takes requests, keeps 2-4 items in flight within budget, and keeps the person's inbox. The orchestrator is the session that sent ORCHESTRATOR_STARTED last; items take its id from here. It also opens the day's stand-in audit (AUDIT_PICKED), once per day, as a child audit actor (spec audit).

person.description: The person: acts only by a tap on a card the machine asked for, and holds no role.

session.description: A Claude Code session (a thread): id CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID, which the CLI takes from the platform. It never contains '/'.

agent.description: A subagent of a session: id <session_id>/<agent_id>, the session's CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID and the agent_id of the hook input, so it names both; type is its agent_type. The plugin's PreToolUse hook hands it to every harness call a subagent runs (HARNESS_AGENT=<agent_id>:<agent_type>) and the CLI records it as this actor; its SubagentStart hook files a record that harness verify-actors checks it against. Two subagents of one session are two actors, and neither is the session.

github.description: GitHub: only through harness from-github, after its REST API agrees.

timer.description: The harness's own clock (tick, digest, canary).

meta.roles: Actors marked roles (session and agent) are recorded in an item's roles and compared there by the whole actor, kind and id: the id patterns are disjoint, so the recorded id names one actor. An event whose actor is not one of these kinds, or whose id does not match its kind's pattern, is refused before any machine sees it.

store.description: The layout of a store's state.json. Every write records the spec's schemaVersion beside the snapshot; a state.json without one was written before the field and has layout 1. A page declares the range it reads (pages/<page>/needs.json, reads.schemaVersion) and, on a store outside it, shows a red banner naming the mismatch and no data. Raise it when a change moves or renames anything a page reads.

pages.description: A page refreshes only when a viewer presses its refresh button: nothing refreshes on a schedule or without a viewer. Each refresh is timed from the press to the rendered page and recorded as one row in the Artifact db collection refreshCollection ({page, at, ms, storeVersion, schemaVersion, bytes, ok}); the page shows the recent rows, and harness doctor --refreshes flags a row slower than refreshSlowMs.

ORCHESTRATOR_STARTED.description: Refused unless the actor is a session. Its id becomes the orchestrator's, here and in every queued or in-flight item, so no run it reports itself is taken.

AUDIT_PICKED.description: Refused unless a session sends it: the session that read the decision log and picked (harness audit).

Refused unless its day is the UTC day of the event's own time (receivedAt: the at the runtime logs it with, never the sender's word), so a past or future day is refused and there is at most one audit per real day, a day not audited before, and it names 1 to max picks, each a logPrecedent effect id. The picks name decisions only; what each decided is read from the store's own outbox, never from the event.

REQUEST_RECEIVED.description: Refused when the request has no id, or sets a field the work item's machine holds (tier, criteria, checks, workers, orchestrator, requester and the rest of its context, all but id and project). The filer names the work; triage sets the tier and the criteria. The requester is the event's actor, recorded by the item.

scheduler.description: Holds the WIP limit. WIP_SET from the orchestrator records a new wipLimit (the first one keeps init's as wipLimitAtInit, which replay starts from); outside accepting it starts nothing, and lowering it never stops an item in flight. An item that finishes, even one cancelled while still queued, leaves inFlight and queued, so no slot goes to it; and whenever items start, any id in inFlight or queued whose item has already finished is dropped (a store from before that rule), so a finished item never holds a slot.

BUDGET_MODE.description: Sent by the budget actor when its mode changes inside the harness; the same event from outside (any event with an actor) is refused.

ITEM_PARKED.description: Sent by an item when it enters needsCriteria: it waits on the person and gives up its slot. The same event from outside (any event with an actor) is refused.

WIP_SET.description: Refused unless the orchestrator's own session sends it (the actor is a session whose id is context.orchestrator): any other session, an agent, the person or a tap is refused. The orchestrator routes the work, so it alone sets how much runs at once.
Refused unless limit is an integer from min to max.

accepting.description: Start ready items while fewer than wipLimit are in flight, and again at once when WIP_SET raises the limit.

Refused unless limit is an integer from min to max.

draining.description: Soft budget limit: nothing new starts; items in flight are told to wrap up.

halted.description: Budget stop: nothing runs until usage allows.

needsPerson.description: The person's inbox is not empty: it holds every open decision and every item waiting in needsCriteria, and each leaves it when it closes (DECISION_CLOSED).
